reason: A guided AI-tutor plugin that turns documents, local folders, or GitHub learning repositories into structured courses with concept mastery, quizzes, learner memory, notes, and spaced-repetition reviews.

summaries.zh: 将文档、本地文件夹或 GitHub 学习仓库转换为带有概念掌握度、测验、学习记忆、笔记和间隔复习的引导式 AI 课程。
summaries.en: Turns documents, local folders, or GitHub learning repositories into guided AI-tutor courses with concept mastery, quizzes, learner memory, notes, and spaced-repetition reviews.

capabilities: Imports markdown documents, local folders, and GitHub learning repositories
Provides an AI-tutor chat workflow with quizzes, mastery tracking, and spaced-repetition reviews
Persists learner progress, notes, memory, and course state
Serves a browser study tab and HTTP state API in the web profile
